title: Design System: Sean Tan — The Instrument

display.purpose: The hero name only. Solid Ink, never gradient-clipped.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the contact statement.

label.purpose: Martian Mono instrumentation — HUD chrome, tags, coordinates. Never body.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Default UI state transitions (insets, brightening, ring).

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Ambient loops — live-dot pulse, scroll cue sweep.

components.name: Primary Button (CTA / Skip)
components.description: The only place Lichen Glow is a fill: the skip link and any primary CTA. Field-Deep text, mono label, near-square.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.82 0.17 142); color: oklch(0.055 0 0); font-family: 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 0.6rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.82 0.17 142); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Section Tag
components.description: Mono, uppercase, wide-tracked Lichen Glow label. Section identifier — a deliberate HUD readout, not a decorative eyebrow.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.82 0.17 142); }

components.name: Contact Link Row
components.description: Full-width row on a hairline grid: mono Lichen Glow label, Ink-Dim value, Lichen Glow arrow. Insets and brightens on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-link { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7rem 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 1.2rem; padding: 1.25rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.28 0.01 150 / 0.32); color: oklch(0.82 0.01 150); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), padding-left 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-link__label { font-family: 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.82 0.17 142); } .ds-link__value { font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-link__arrow { color: oklch(0.82 0.17 142); transition: translate 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { color: oklch(0.95 0.008 150); padding-left: 0.8rem; } .ds-link:hover .ds-link__arrow { translate: 5px 0; }

components.name: Disclosure Row
components.description: Accessible accordion row on hairline dividers: mono index, Muted title (brightens to Ink), mono meta, a Lichen Glow + toggle.
components.css: .ds-disc { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; width: 100%; padding: 1.9rem 0; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.28 0.01 150 / 0.32); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: padding-left 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-disc:hover, .ds-disc:focus-visible { padding-left: 1.2rem; outline: none; } .ds-disc__idx { font-family: 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; color: oklch(0.82 0.17 142); } .ds-disc__name { font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: oklch(0.64 0.015 150); transition: color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-disc:hover .ds-disc__name, .ds-disc:focus-visible .ds-disc__name { color: oklch(0.95 0.008 150); } .ds-disc__meta { font-family: 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; color: oklch(0.58 0.012 150); letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-disc__plus { position: relative; width: 15px; height: 15px; } .ds-disc__plus::before, .ds-disc__plus::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 50% 0 auto 0; height: 1px; background: oklch(0.82 0.17 142); } .ds-disc__plus::after { rotate: 90deg; }

components.name: HUD Section Readout
components.description: The persistent instrument readout: current section index and name, mono, Ink-Dim with a Lichen Glow label. Driven by a viewport-center IntersectionObserver.
components.css: .ds-hud { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4ch; font-family: 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: oklch(0.82 0.01 150); font-weight: 500; } .ds-hud__dim { color: oklch(0.58 0.012 150); } .ds-hud__label { margin-left: 0.4ch; color: oklch(0.82 0.17 142); letter-spacing: 0.16em; }

narrative.overview: A personal site conceived as a living instrument — a panel you operate, not a page you read. A luminous signal-green reads like transmission light against a deep near-black field, and a persistent HUD frame (corner brackets, live UTC clock, pointer coordinates, section readout, scroll-progress rail) wraps every screen so the whole experience is seen through one lens. Depth is the organizing idea: layered translucent planes, a receding WebGL signal field, and cursor-aware parallax. Motion is structural — one orchestrated page-load, line-by-line reveals, magnetic focus-pulls — never decorative flash. The mood is an aerospace / signals console at night: cold precision, a single warm-cool tension between the green signal and a bone highlight, quiet until you touch it. It is unapologetically a demonstration of craft — the execution is the message — so restraint and polish outrank spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-native field (near-black, chroma 0) with one committed signal-green voice
A persistent HUD/instrument frame as the cohesion device across all sections
Depth through layering: WebGL field + translucent planes + pointer parallax
Structural motion with a first-class prefers-reduced-motion fallback
Sans display (Archivo) paired with a mono instrument voice (Martian Mono)
OKLCH throughout; contrast verified to WCAG AA against the shipped dark theme

rules.name: The Signal-Is-Light Rule
rules.body: Lichen Glow is treated as emitted light, not paint: glow, hairline, small mark, single word, one filled control. It never becomes a large fill behind text. Its rarity is what makes it read as signal.

rules.name: The Chroma-Zero Field Rule
rules.body: The background is pure neutral (chroma 0). Warmth lives only in the Bone accent and the green's own hue — never tinted into the surface.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Instrumentation Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono appears only where the UI is acting as an instrument — readouts, coordinates, tags, labels. It is forbidden for body copy or headings.

rules.name: The Solid-Display Rule
rules.body: Display and headline text is a single solid color. Gradient-clipped text is prohibited, even a subtle tonal one — hierarchy comes from size, weight, and the field glow behind.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Box-shadows are prohibited. If an element needs to feel lifted, it moves in z (parallax), catches the field's glow, or gains a hairline — it never drops a shadow.

dos: Do keep the field pure neutral (chroma 0) and let Lichen Glow and the Bone accent carry all warmth/coolness.
Do treat Lichen Glow as light — small marks, hairlines, single words, one filled control. Keep it off large text backgrounds.
Do verify contrast against the shipped dark theme: body ≥4.5:1, large ≥3:1. Faint (0.58) is the dim floor at 4.86:1 — never dim metadata further.
Do give every animation a first-class prefers-reduced-motion path, and keep content visible by default (reveals enhance, never gate).
Do reserve Martian Mono for instrumentation — readouts, tags, labels.
Do convey depth with layering, parallax, and glow.
donts: Don't use gradient-clipped text, even a subtle tonal one — display type is a single solid color; emphasis comes from size and weight.
Don't add box-shadows or glassmorphism-by-default — depth is optical (field, parallax, glow), not paper-drop-shadow.
Don't tint the background warm or cool 'because the brand feels that way' — that produces the AI-default dark theme.
Don't drift into the generic SaaS / startup look: rounded-card grids, purple gradients, the hero-metric template.
Don't go cream / warm minimal-lifestyle or corporate / stock-photo blandness.
Don't over-animate: no scroll-jacking, no bounce/elastic easing, no motion for its own sake.
Don't use Martian Mono for body copy or headings — mono-as-costume.
Don't put numbered eyebrows on every section; the numeric readouts here are a deliberate HUD instrument system.
